newsitem.title: USA: Best Products names Edward Clingman CEO.
newsitem.headline: Best Products names Edward Clingman CEO.

text.p: Best Products Co Inc said on Friday it named W. Edward Clingman Jr. to succeed Daniel Levy as chief executive officer.
Clingman would also serve as president, the company said. Levy has terminated his employment but would continue as chairman of its board of directors, Best said.

Clingman would direct the liquidation of Best's remaining assets and properties and the conclusion of its affairs. He joined the company in 1993 and had served as senior vice president, general counsel and secretary, it said.
